messages:
lina: Weekly check-in for Velora — focusing on token usage + throughput. Quick ask: any anomalies last 7d vs prior week? Key points: WoW tokens -6%, QoQ +12%; saw a p95 latency spike Wed ~11:00 (~2.4s). Adding raw counts below. Thoughts?

raj: Pulled the telemetry, summary below:
```
period    tokens/day   p95_latency   errors/hr
this_wk   420k         2400ms        1.2
prior_wk  450k         1100ms        0.3
qoq_avg   375k         900ms         0.2
```
Main suspect: velora-aggregator nightly job increased average prompt length ~20% (more metadata). Error surface mainly 5xx rate limited traces from model variant fallback.

matt: Noted. CS action: flag eng onboarding to review the batch shaping. @nora can you check aggregator config and recent deploys? Also what's the immediate spend impact? :eyes:

nora: I'll take this. Quick note — cache miss rate jumped after the Wed deploy. Rolling back cache TTL on Wed evening temporarily reduced p95 by ~600ms for a bit. Will confirm if the deploy changed prefix caching.

lina: Spend snapshot: ~$4.8k last 7d vs $5.4k prior week — tokens down WoW consistent with spend drop. Concern is user-facing latency spike which could hurt retention. Marking renewal risk as medium if unaddressed.

deploy-bot: velora-aggregator v2.3 deployed by nora at 2026-03-18T10:42Z — changelog: adjust batch window, alter input normalization.

raj: Short-term mitigation suggestions:
- pin batch window to pre-roll period for 48h
- enable KV warmup for top 50 prefixes
- add a light pre-tokenization step to reduce avg tokens per prompt
I'll run a test flow tomorrow 09:00 UTC and post results.

matt: I'll prepare an enablement note for the Velora PM + ops contact with the rollback/playbook. Assigning follow-ups in CS board, ETA EOD. :white_check_mark:

lina: Thanks team. We'll reconvene Friday for status. If we still see p95 > 1.2s we'll open enterprise escalation and offer a short performance review session with Velora. Closing action items: raj->test run, nora->confirm deploy effects, matt->customer comms.

matt: one more — capture any user-visible errors (sample traces) and include in the Friday deck.

lina: ACK.
